event.title: Cincinnati Zoo's Beloved Hippo Fiona Dies After Eating Visitor's Hat
event.canonical_title: Cincinnati Zoo's Beloved Hippo Fiona Dies After Eating Visitor's Hat
event.summary: Fiona, a Nile hippopotamus at the Cincinnati Zoo, has died after ingesting a hat that entered her enclosure. The zoo reported her death days after the incident, which drew attention due to Fiona's previous fame from her premature birth.

timeline.title: Cincinnati Zoo's Beloved Hippo Fiona Dies After Eating Visitor's Hat
timeline.summary: Fiona, the famous hippo at the Cincinnati Zoo, has died at the age of 9 after complications from swallowing a knitted hat that fell into her enclosure. The zoo announced her passing, stating that despite multiple attempts by veterinary staff to save her, she did not survive the medical emergency. Fiona was known for her premature birth and became a global sensation, capturing the hearts of many.
key_facts: Fiona the hippo died after swallowing a hat.
She was 9 years old at the time of her death.
The incident occurred at the Cincinnati Zoo.
